display_title: Moonlit Night, Moonlit Sleep, Moonlit Cup
description:
Baekri Cheongra, the top disciple of the Howol Sect. Renowned throughout the martial arts world for his achievements far surpassing those of her peers his elegant and beautiful appearance, and his righteous character, he harbored a strange and secretive desire that would surely draw scorn from others if they were to find out. That desire was the longing to be completely subjugated by someone. Then, Dang Ran-Yeong of the Sacheon Clan appeared before Cheongra. Though he was notorious throughout the martial arts world for his vicious and ruthless deeds, Cheong-Ra’s heart began to stir at his imposing presence, sculpted features, and formidable martial prowess...

 *“Young Master Baek-Ri, I never would have guessed that someone with such a refined face and noble demeanor would be such a pervert.”*

 *“Young Master Dang, I want you to… treat me despicably.”*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
